securityFlags.description: JWT_SECRET has hardcoded fallback value in multiple files
securityFlags.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallback secrets. Use proper secret management and fail if JWT_SECRET is not set in production.

securityFlags.description: Real credentials found in .env.local file (CLERK_SECRET_KEY and VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN)
securityFlags.recommendation: The .env.local file is properly gitignored, but ensure these credentials are rotated if they were ever committed. Consider using a secrets manager for production.

securityFlags.description: Admin password stored in NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable
securityFlags.recommendation: NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables are exposed to the client. Consider using a server-side validation approach for admin features.

recommendations: Rotate all secrets found in .env.local files if they were ever committed to version control
Remove hardcoded fallback secrets from source code
Consider using a secrets management solution for production deployments
Add pre-commit hooks to prevent accidental commit of sensitive files
